transcript.text: Hi everyone. As we all know, we need to clear the farmhouse by August 31, and there are four categories of items still needing a plan: the oak dining table, the sewing cabinet, twelve boxes of books, and four framed paintings. Before I put together a final plan, I'd like to go around the group so everyone can raise any practical or personal considerations. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I'd like to keep the sewing cabinet, if no one else has a claim on it. I can collect it from the farmhouse on August 24.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I measured the farmhouse recently — the front doorway is 88 centimeters wide, the side doorway is 110 centimeters wide, and the oak table is 96 centimeters wide. So the table can go out intact through the side doorway, but not through the front. Worth keeping in mind for the transport plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I should mention that I spoke with the county historical society, and they've agreed to accept all four framed paintings — but only if we deliver them between August 20 and August 22. I haven't had a chance to bring this to the group until now, so here it is.
transcript.speaker: A4
